title: Page 5
content_zh:
「三公子，早。」她朝他恭敬地行礼。
戚无秋只是淡淡地瞧了她一眼，然后点点头回应，不想和她有太多的牵扯。
每每看到娇小的她，总会不自觉担心起她来，就怕她无法胜任丫鬟的工作，他不习惯这么注意一个人，而且她还只是个丫鬟，所以总是故作冷淡，想藉此拉开两人之间的距离。
她不小心依偎在他怀里的那一幕，虽然早已过去很久，但在他脑海中还是印象鲜明，甚至属于她的香气，好像也还萦绕在他身边，久久不散，让他一直觉得非常困扰。
紧接着从内房出来的是每天从镖局过来叫醒戚无秋的少年阿久，他一看到草儿手中还端着沉重的托盘，赶紧笑着靠过来帮忙。「草儿姑娘，我来帮你把早膳放上桌。」
「谢谢阿久哥。」她漾起甜甜的笑，非常诚恳地感谢他。
草儿毫无心机的对阿久漾起甜而柔的好看笑容，这让戚无秋瞬间感到非常的不是滋味，一早起来火气就不小。
这个丫头每回面对他时，都是一副小媳妇的委屈模样，好像他多么虐待她一样，但他明明就什么事情都没对她做，顶多就是不太理她而已。
但她每回面对阿久，都笑得非常甜美可人，那反差之大，让他觉得非常的不满，老是有一股冲动，很想把阿久给踢出去。
她明明就是他的贴身丫鬟，她和一个外人这么亲近是在干什么，她眼里到底还有没有他这个主子存在？
说不想在意，但他还是忍不住在意着她的一举一动，她对别人笑，就是不对他这个主子笑，这让他很在意、非常在意，在意到忍不住想发火！
「哼！」戚无秋故意哼了一声，然后就在椅子上坐下，摆明了「本公子正在不悦」当中，生人勿扰。
草儿和阿久当然知道他的意思，赶紧收敛态度，恭敬地将早膳给摆上桌，不敢再多说什么话。
将早膳都摆上桌之后，草儿和阿久也跟着坐下来和戚无秋一起用膳，他是个不拘小节的人，也不习惯下人们在一旁站着服侍他用膳，所以他都会要求他们跟着一起吃。
草儿静静地吃着自己的饭，眼光却经常偷偷地瞄往戚无秋的方向看，她不知道自己又哪里惹了主子生气，感到有些丧气，如果她再机灵一点的话，或许就知道为什么每天一早主子脸色都不太好了。
她不希望主子总是对她板着脸，这样会害她跟着紧张，想笑都笑不出来，但她又不知道该怎么办才好，只能继续让彼此之间的关系僵硬下去，不知道什么时候才能够缓和下来。
她真的很希望，主子能够喜欢她，别再避她避得远远的……
好不容易，一顿安静到诡异的早膳时间终于结束，草儿起身尽责地开始收拾桌面，努力做好丫鬟的本分。
「草儿姑娘，我来帮你收拾碗盘。」阿久好心地起身想帮忙收拾，反正他在镖局也打杂打习惯了，帮忙一下一点都不觉得有什么。
「谢谢阿久哥……」她无以回报，只能感激地再次道谢。

眼看着草儿又要对阿久漾起甜美的笑容了，戚无秋双眉一蹙，故意开口干扰他们。「阿久，既然已经用完早膳，你赶紧回镖局去，顺便告诉其他人，我今天午后才会进镖局处理事情。」
哼，想对他的丫鬟献殷勤？也得看他准不准呀！
「喔，好，不过先让我帮完草儿姑娘吧。」他根本就没有意识到有人已经下逐客令了。
「不必了，你让她自己收拾就好，反正这是她的工作。」啧，还真是个完全看不懂状况的蠢蛋！
草儿看到主子似乎又要开始生气，赶紧说道：「阿久哥，我自己收拾就好了，你快回镖局去吧。」
「可是你……」
「只是收拾个碗盘而已，又没有什么，我自己可以应付，真的。」她一连点了好几个头，就怕他硬是要继续帮下去。
既然连草儿都说不必帮忙，阿久只好搔搔头，不再帮忙，真搞不懂老大哪时变得这么小气，连个忙都不让他帮。
「那……老大，阿久先走一步了。」他觉得老大好像对草儿特别在意，但在意的方式似乎怪怪的，但到底是怎样的奇怪法，他又说不上来。
「嗯。」他淡淡地应了一声，算是回答了。
阿久离开之后，草儿也差不多收拾好桌面，退出去前她小心翼翼地问：「三公子，早膳之后有什么事情奴婢可以帮忙的吗？」
「不必，我会在书房看兵书、帐，如果没事，你就别进书房打扰我，其他地方你爱怎么忙就怎么忙，反正你自己找事情做就是。」帮忙？她别帮倒忙，他就已经要谢天谢地了。
她沮丧地垮下小脸，非常没有元气地回道：「喔，奴婢知道了。」
他总是这样，将她遣得远远的，都不让她靠近帮忙，好像她是瘟神一样，她的心很受伤，很酸、很涩，却也只能乖乖听话，免得让他更加讨厌她。
她是真的很不讨人喜欢吗？都怪她太笨手笨脚，她要继续努力，要让自己变得聪明伶俐一点，才不会被主子一直讨厌下去。
但到底该怎么做才能变得聪明伶俐？她单纯的脑子根本思考不了如此高深的问题，只能端着碗盘默默的退出房，往厨房的方向走去。
想变聪明……应该很难吧？凭她这么钝的脑子，应该是没救了，唉……
坐在书房里，其实戚无秋有些心不在焉，从前他只要一开始看起兵书，就会非常沉迷地一直看下去，什么事情都打扰不了他，但最近这种状况却突然开始有所改变。
因为草儿那个丫头，害他破天荒地分了神，怎样都无法静下心来看他最爱的兵书。
「啧，烦死了……」将手上看没几页的兵书给暂时搁在书桌上，戚无秋此刻脑袋里想的还是草儿的状况，他要她随便找事情做，她会找什么事情来折磨自己？

她有些迟钝，还笨手笨脚的，有时候思考事情时像是脑袋被什么东西给卡住一样，然后就傻傻地愣住，所以让他忍不住担心，总是心神不宁，对她的牵挂没来由的多。
这是从来没有发生过的事，他之前的贴身丫鬟没有一个能够让他注意到这种程度，或许……也和她的太过迟钝有关系吧。
不行不行，越想越不对，越想越不放心，他还是去看一下的好，免得她又出了什么差错，到最后倒霉的还是他！
「没错，还是去看看的好！」看了不一定安心，但不看绝对安不了心，所以他势必还是得走这一遭。
从椅子上起身，戚无秋走出书房，开始在院里寻找草儿的身影，只不过他找了几个她比较常出没的地点，都没有找到她，这让他不由得纳闷，想不透她到底会到什么地方去。
「奇怪，她能躲到哪去？我的院子也就这么大而……呃？」找到一半，他突然发现自己的兵器房房门大开，像是有人闯进去，一瞬间他的头皮发麻，有种非常不好的预感，赶紧走了过去。
她该不会在里面吧？依她的笨手笨脚，还敢进到兵器房，她是不要命了吗？
虽然他的兵器房里没放什么珍贵的刀剑，都是从前拿来练习用的旧东西，但也杀伤力惊人呀，平常都是锁起来的，不过想要进去也不难，找他或是戚总管拿钥匙就开得了，不过他真的没想到，她的脑筋会动到他的兵器房头上。
content_en:
"Good morning, Third Young Master." She saluted him respectfully.
Qi Wuqiu just glanced at her lightly, then nodded in response, not wanting to get too involved with her.
Every time he saw her petite body, he would unconsciously worry about her, fearing that she would not be able to do the job of a maid. He was not used to paying so much attention to someone, and she was only a maid, so he always pretended to be indifferent, hoping to put some distance between them.
The scene where she accidentally snuggled into his arms, although it had been a long time ago, was still vivid in his mind, and even her fragrance seemed to still linger around him, lingering for a long time, making him feel very troubled.
The next person who came out of the inner room was Ajiu, the young man who came from the escort office to wake up Qi Wuqiu every day. When he saw Cao'er still holding a heavy tray in his hand, he quickly smiled and leaned over to help. "Miss Cao'er, let me help you put breakfast on the table."
"Thank you, Brother Ajiu." She smiled sweetly and thanked him very sincerely.
Cao'er gave Ajiu a sweet and soft smile without any thought, which made Qi Wuqiu feel very uncomfortable in an instant, and he was very angry when he got up early in the morning.
Every time this girl faced him, she looked like a wronged little daughter-in-law, as if he had abused her, but he clearly didn't do anything to her. At most, he just ignored her.
But every time she faced Ajiu, she smiled very sweetly. The contrast was so great that he felt very dissatisfied. He always had the urge to kick Ajiu out.
She is obviously his personal maid, so why is she so close to an outsider? Does she still think of him as her master?
She said she didn't want to care, but he couldn't help but care about her every move. She smiled at others, but not at him, his master. This made him care, very much, to the point where he couldn't help but want to get angry!
"Huh!" Qi Wuqiu snorted deliberately, then sat down on the chair, making it clear that "I am unhappy" and did not disturb anyone.
Of course Cao'er and Ajiu knew what he meant, so they quickly restrained their attitude and put the breakfast on the table respectfully, not daring to say anything more.
After putting the breakfast on the table, Cao'er and Ajiu also sat down to eat with Qi Wuqiu. He was an informal person and was not used to people standing aside to serve him while eating, so he would ask them to eat with him.
Cao'er ate her meal quietly, but her eyes often glanced in Qi Wuqiu's direction. She didn't know how she had made her master angry, and she felt a little frustrated. If she were smarter, she might know why his master looked so bad every morning.
She didn't want her master to always have a straight face towards her, which would make her nervous and unable to laugh even if she wanted to. But she didn't know what to do. She could only continue to make the relationship between them stiff, and she didn't know when it would be able to relax.
She really hopes that her master will like her and stop avoiding her...
Finally, the eerily quiet breakfast time finally came to an end. Cao'er got up and started to clear the table responsibly, trying her best to do her duty as a maid.
"Miss Cao'er, let me help you clean up the dishes." Ajiu kindly stood up and wanted to help clean up. Anyway, he was used to doing odd jobs in the escort agency, so it didn't feel like anything to help.
"Thank you, Brother Ajiu..." She had nothing to say in return, so she could only express her gratitude again gratefully.
Seeing that Cao'er was about to smile sweetly at Ajiu again, Qi Wuqiu frowned and deliberately opened his mouth to disturb them. "Ajiu, since you've finished your breakfast, hurry back to the escort office and tell the others that I won't go into the escort office until this afternoon to handle matters."
Humph, want to be courteous to his maid? It depends on whether he is accurate or not!
"Oh, okay, but let me finish helping Miss Cao'er first." He didn't even realize that someone had already kicked him out.Customer order.
"No need, just let her clean up by herself. It's her job anyway." Tsk, what an idiot who doesn't understand the situation at all!
Seeing that his master seemed to be angry again, Cao'er quickly said, "Brother Ajiu, I can just clean up myself. You can go back to the escort agency."
"But you..."
"It's just a matter of clearing away the dishes. It's nothing. I can handle it myself, really." She nodded several times, fearing that he would insist on continuing to help.
Since even Cao'er said there was no need to help, Ajiu could only scratch his head and stop helping. I really don't understand when the boss became so stingy and wouldn't even let him help.
"Then...Boss, Ajiu has taken the first step." He felt that the boss seemed to be particularly concerned about Cao'er, but the way he cared seemed strange, but he couldn't tell what kind of strange method it was.
"Yeah." He responded lightly, which was considered an answer.
After Ajiu left, Cao'er had almost cleared the table. Before exiting, she asked carefully: "Third Young Master, is there anything I can help you with after breakfast?"
"No, I will read the military books and accounts in the study. If nothing happens, don't come into the study to disturb me. You can be as busy as you like in other places. Anyway, you just have to find something to do." Help? He would be thankful if she didn't help him.
She lowered her face in frustration and replied very weakly: "Oh, I know this."
He was always like this, sending her far away and not letting her get close to help, as if she was the god of plague. Her heart was hurt, sour, and astringent, but she could only be obedient to avoid making him hate her even more.
Is she really so unlikeable? It's all her fault for being too clumsy. She must continue to work hard and become smarter so that she won't be hated by her master all the time.
But what exactly do you do to become smarter? Her simple mind couldn't think about such a profound question, so she could only silently exit the room with the dishes in hand and walk towards the kitchen.
Wanting to be smart...should be difficult, right? With her dull mind, she is probably hopeless, alas...
Sitting in the study, Qi Wuqiu was actually a little absent-minded. In the past, as soon as he started reading the book of war, he would continue to read it very addictedly, and nothing could disturb him. But recently, this situation suddenly began to change.
Because of that girl Cao'er, he was distracted for the first time and couldn't calm down to read his favorite book on war.
"Tsk, I'm so annoyed..." Putting the few pages of the military book in his hand on the desk, Qi Wuqiu was still thinking about Cao'er's condition at the moment. He asked her to find something to do casually, what kind of thing would she find to torture herself?
She was a little slow and clumsy, and sometimes when she was thinking about things, it felt like her head was stuck with something, and then she would freeze up stupidly, so he couldn't help but worry, he was always restless, and he cared about her for no reason.
This was something that had never happened before. None of his previous personal maids could make him notice it to this extent. Perhaps...it had something to do with her being too slow.
No, no, the more he thought about it, the more wrong it became, and the more he thought about it, the more uneasy he became, he had better go and have a look, lest she make another mistake, and he would be the unlucky one in the end!
"That's right, it's better to go and take a look!" You may not feel at ease if you look at it, but you definitely won't feel at ease if you don't look at it, so he must still make this trip.
Standing up from the chair, Qi Wuqiu walked out of the study and began to look for Cao'er in the courtyard. However, he searched a few places where she frequented but could not find her. This made him wonder where she would go.
"It's strange, where can she hide? My yard is only so big and... eh?" Halfway through, he suddenly found that the door of his weapons room was wide open, as if someone had broken in, and for a moment his headMy skin was numb and I had a very bad feeling, so I hurried over.
Could she be in there? Based on her clumsiness, she still dared to enter the weapons room. Was she going to die?
Although there are no precious swords in his weapon room, they are all old things that were used for practice in the past, but they are also incredibly lethal. They are usually locked, but it is not difficult to get in. You can just ask him or Manager Qi to get the key, but he really didn't expect that her brain would touch his weapon room.
